صحفي ومحرر أخبار

01 / الخبرات الصحفية

الخبرات الصحفية

مهام تحريرية في غرفة أخبار دولية، تشمل الديسك والتغطيات العاجلة وإعداد المواد للنشر الرقمي.

01

الكتابة والتحرير الصحفي

إعداد الأخبار والتقارير والتحقيقات والخلفيات الإخبارية والمواد التحليلية، وتحريرها للنشر.

تفاصيل الخبرة +
  • جمع المعلومات والتواصل مع المصادر لاستكمال عناصر القصة الصحفية.
  • تحرير مواد المراسلين والمسودات، وبناء النص وترتيب المعلومات وفق أهميتها الخبرية.
  • تحديد الزاوية الخبرية وصياغة العناوين والمقدمات.
  • تغطية ملفات السياسة والاقتصاد والرياضة والثقافة والفنون والعلوم والشؤون الاجتماعية.
02

التحقق من صحة المعلومات والمراجعة قبل النشر

فحص المعلومات والتصريحات قبل النشر، وتدقيق البيانات الأساسية، والتمييز بين الوقائع والاستنتاجات.

تفاصيل الخبرة +
  • تقييم موثوقية المصادر والرجوع إلى الأصول للتحقق من دقة النقل والسياق.
  • تدقيق الأسماء والأرقام والتواريخ والاقتباسات.
  • ضبط الإسناد وتحرير الصياغات التي تحمل استنتاجات لا تسندها الأدلة.
  • إجراء المراجعة اللغوية والتحريرية النهائية قبل النشر.
03

الأخبار العاجلة وتنسيق التغطية

متابعة تطورات الحدث وتحديث التغطية، والمساهمة في ترتيب الأولويات والتخطيط التحريري اليومي.

تفاصيل الخبرة +
  • المشاركة في توزيع المهام ومتابعة سير العمل خلال بعض المناوبات وفترات كثافة الأخبار.
  • التنسيق مع المحررين والمراسلين لاستكمال عناصر التغطية.
  • إنجاز المواد في المواعيد المحددة مع الالتزام بالدقة والتحقق.
  • المشاركة في تغطيات ميدانية لأحداث كبرى ضمن تكليفات العمل الصحفي.
04

الصحافة الرقمية وإدارة المحتوى

تكييف المادة الصحفية للمواقع ومنصات التواصل، وإعداد النصوص والعناصر البصرية وفق طبيعة المنصة.

تفاصيل الخبرة +
  • كتابة التنبيهات والنصوص المختصرة وفق أولوية المعلومة وطبيعة المنصة.
  • تحرير التعليقات المصاحبة للصور والفيديو والتحقق من اتساقها مع المادة.
  • اختيار العناصر البصرية المناسبة وربطها بسياق التغطية.
  • النشر باستخدام WordPress ومنصات التواصل الاجتماعي.
05

الفيديو والتعليق الصوتي

إعداد التقارير المصوّرة وكتابة نصوصها وتسجيل التعليق الصوتي، إلى جانب المونتاج والترجمة السمعية البصرية.

تفاصيل الخبرة +
  • اختيار اللقطات وترتيبها وبناء تسلسل يخدم القصة.
  • تحويل المادة المكتوبة إلى نص مناسب للسرد المرئي والصوتي.
  • ترجمة الفيديو من الإسبانية والإنجليزية إلى العربية وإعداد الترجمة المصاحبة.
  • مراجعة دقة النص والتعليق الصوتي واتساقهما مع الصور.
06

الترجمة والتحرير متعدد اللغات

ترجمة المواد الصحفية من الإسبانية والإنجليزية إلى العربية ومراجعتها، مع الحفاظ على المعنى والسياق.

تفاصيل الخبرة +
  • مراجعة دقة نقل التصريحات والاقتباسات.
  • صياغة الترجمة بعربية صحفية طبيعية ومتسقة.
  • تدقيق المصطلحات والأسماء والأرقام والتواريخ مقابل الأصل.
  • متابعة المراجع والمصادر المتاحة باللغات الثلاث لاستكمال البحث.

معاينة نص التحقيق كاملًا +
نموذج استقصائي غير منشور · باللغة الإنجليزية

UNPUBLISHED INVESTIGATIVE WRITING SAMPLE

Inside FIFA’s Trump Network: The Ecosystem That Collapsed Because It Was Seen

By Mohamed Anwar and Shereen Sherif | August 2026

On March 26, 2026, a limited partnership called THRIVE ETERNAL FEEDER, L.P. was quietly registered in Delaware, appointing Corporation Service Company as its registered agent. Four months later, on July 29, FIFA publicly announced that Joshua Kushner's Thrive Eternal would lead a group of investors in a proposed $4.2 billion deal to take a stake in world football's commercial operations. FIFA's governing body, the soccer world and the United States Congress were all learning about the proposal for the first time.

The legal machinery had been running since late March. The public announcement was the last step, not the first. The Delaware record is one of three documents — alongside Foreign Agents Registration Act filings and a presidential financial disclosure — that, read together, show the structural timeline behind what has been reported as a political relationship. They reveal not a friendship that produced transactions, but a set of financial and institutional arrangements that were built, in sequence, before the public knew they existed.

The proposal collapsed on August 1, 2026, under a wave of opposition from UEFA, CONCACAF and football's broader governing institutions. But the collapse is not the end of the story. It is the story's most important moment: the first time the full architecture became visible — and the reason it could not survive being seen.

The Documents That Came Before the Announcement

The Thrive Eternal Feeder entity is a feeder partnership — a vehicle used to pool capital from multiple investors before deploying it into a larger structure. Its formation date, confirmed in Delaware corporate records, places the legal groundwork for the FIFA deal four months before FIFA's membership, oversight bodies or the public had any knowledge of it. J.P. Morgan, which FIFA later confirmed as its financial adviser for the deal, was reportedly brought in during the same period to develop the capital structure.

A secondary overlap in the public record. Corporation Service Company CSC the registered agent for the Thrive Eternal feeder partnership, appears in formation filings for FIFA Americas and for Trump-linked entities including Trump Endeavor 12 LLC and Trump International Golf Club, L.C. Shared registered agents are common in corporate practice and do not establish a connection between those entities. The overlap is documented and its significance, lies in a pattern of institutional proximity.

A third document locates the key principals in a shared access environment before either the FIFA deal or the World Cup itself. FARA filings submitted by Richard Attias & Associates — the American firm retained to organize the Saudi Public Investment Fund-backed FII Institute Priority Summit — describe the February 19, 2025 event at the Faena Hotel in Miami as involving political activities and note that discussions with speakers covered themes and pillars including issues related to U.S. policy. Contact records cited in those filings identify interactions involving President Trump, PIF Governor Yasir Al-Rumayyan, Jared Kushner and FIFA President Gianni Infantino. The same filings show the PIF-backed institute paid Richard Attias & Associates more than $5.6 million for services linked to the event.

The filings do not reveal what was discussed. They establish the setting: a Saudi-funded investment platform placed the U.S. president, FIFA's president, Trump's son-in-law and the governor of one of the world's most powerful sovereign wealth funds inside the same documented access environment — five months before FIFA opened an office in Trump Tower.

The Price of Proximity

The financial relationship between FIFA and the Trump Organisation became public in July 2025, when Infantino announced that FIFA was opening an office on the 17th floor of Trump Tower. The lease's duration, cost, approval process and competing properties considered were not disclosed. Rep. Jamie Raskin, the ranking Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee, estimated in a subsequent oversight letter that comparable Manhattan office space might retail for approximately $600,000 a year. FIFA denied that its rent was at inflated rates.

The lease was one of three documented transfers of value from FIFA to Trump or a Trump-associated entity. Trump's 2025 federal financial disclosure recorded a personal gift from Infantino: ten tickets to the Club World Cup final at MetLife Stadium, valued at approximately $15,000. Both the lease and the gift were disclosed in public filings. Neither establishes unlawful conduct. Seen with a third element, they form a pattern.

On December 5, 2025, at the 2026 World Cup draw at the Kennedy Centre in Washington, Infantino presented Trump with the inaugural FIFA Peace Prize. Unlike FIFA's established sporting awards, no publicly available rules, nominations process, voting procedure or selection criteria governed the prize before it was awarded. FIFA's account of the ceremony quoted Infantino telling Trump on stage that he could count on his support and on the support of the football community. FairSquare, a human rights organisation, filed a formal complaint with FIFA's Ethics Committee. The committee had not publicly concluded its review by the time this article was written.

The Lobbying Infrastructure

Infantino's personal access to the Trump administration was reinforced by a formal political structure. Federal lobbying disclosures show that FWC2026 US — FIFA's American entity for the tournament — retained K&L Gates to lobby on immigration, homeland security and federal issues connected to the World Cup. The registered lobbying team included Amy Carnevale, who had held senior roles in Trump's 2016 and 2024 presidential campaigns.

This is the anatomy of what the records show: FIFA was paying rent to a Trump property, giving the president personal gifts and institutional awards, and running a lobbying operation through people embedded in his political network — while depending on his administration for visas, border access, security and logistics for the largest sporting event the United States had ever hosted. The dependency was not incidental. It was the condition inside which everything else operated.

The Deal

On July 29, 2026; ten days after the World Cup final, and three days after Raskin sent his congressional oversight letter FIFA publicly unveiled FIFA Forward Enterprise, or FFE. The plan was sweeping: FIFA would move its commercial rights and tournament operations into a new entity valued at approximately $20 billion and raise up to $4.2 billion by selling minority stakes to private investors. Thrive Eternal, the permanent-capital holding company associated with Joshua Kushner, was positioned to lead the investor group. J.P. Morgan was named as financial adviser.

Joshua is the brother of Jared Kushner; Trump's son-in-law, a senior adviser in his first administration and now the CEO of Affinity Partners. That family connection does not establish coordination between them. It gave the FFE proposal an unavoidable political dimension: after FIFA paid rent to a Trump property and honoured the president with a prize, an investment vehicle associated with a member of his extended family was positioned to enter FIFA's commercial core.

Two Brothers, Two Sides of Football

Four days after FIFA unveiled the FFE proposal, on August 4, 2026, a consortium comprising PIF, Silver Lake and Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners completed the approximately $55 billion acquisition of Electronic Arts; the largest leveraged buyout in history. EA owns EA Sports FC, the dominant football video-game franchise. The FIFA-EA licensing partnership ended in 2023, and the public record does not establish that Joshua and Jared Kushner coordinated their investments.

The parallel was nonetheless striking. Had FFE survived, one Kushner brother's vehicle would have held a position inside the commercial structure of physical football while the other's firm participated in ownership of its dominant digital simulation. The same institutions appeared in both transactions: J.P. Morgan advised FIFA on FFE and featured in the EA acquisition financing; PIF; whose governor was documented in the same Miami access environment as Trump, Jared Kushner and Infantino ; was the central investor in the EA consortium.

The Collapse That Revealed the Structure

FIFA abandoned FFE on August 1, 2026 - three days after its public launch - after UEFA voted unanimously to boycott all FIFA competitions if the deal proceeded, CONCACAF and the Asian Football Confederation challenged the governance process, and Carlos Cordeiro, a senior FIFA adviser, resigned.

Infantino confirmed the withdrawal to Sky News: the proposal had "created divisions of a nature that, regardless of the level of support, are no longer in the interest of the objective." The decisive factor was visibility. The deal had been in preparation for at least eighteen months, according to reporting by Axios. During that time, FIFA's member associations and the public knew nothing about it. When The Athletic reported the plan before FIFA could formally announce it, the full sequence became legible at once: the Trump Tower rent, the gifts, the prize, the Miami access environment, the feeder partnership incorporated in March, the J.P. Morgan mandate, the Kushner family connection; all visible in the same week. The football world rejected what it could finally see.

Congressional attention arrived on the same timeline. On July 26, Raskin sent Infantino a formal oversight letter demanding records about the Trump Tower lease, gifts, ticketing practices and FIFA's contacts with Trump and his administration. The letter set an August 9 deadline for documents and requested Infantino appear for a transcribed interview. As of August 13; four days after that deadline , neither FIFA nor Infantino had publicly responded. The White House did not let the letter pass in silence.

A spokesperson called Raskin "a stupid person's idea of a smart person" and praised Trump's leadership in hosting the World Cup. Raskin cannot compel Infantino to testify while Democrats remain in the House minority. But the letter creates a formal record at a politically sensitive moment. A vote of no confidence in Infantino is now being actively discussed within FIFA's governance structure, with a September 23 deadline for items to be added to an Extraordinary Congress agenda. The same week, Trump posted to Truth Social defending Infantino: "FIFA would be making a terrible mistake if, for any reason, they even considered replacing President Gianni Infantino."

The FFE plan is dead. But the architecture it made visible is not. FIFA's office in Trump Tower remains open. The Trump Tower lease; at rates Raskin estimated could reach $600,000 a year; continues to direct FIFA money to a presidential property. The EA acquisition closed on August 4; PIF now owns approximately 93 percent of the company behind football's dominant video game, and Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners holds a stake. J.P. Morgan maintains advisory relationships with entities on multiple sides of these transactions.

The documents in this investigation do not prove that Trump directed FIFA decisions or that the relationship constituted a corrupt bargain in the legal sense. They show something more structural: an ecosystem of money, access and institutional prestige that was built systematically, that the public record partially records, and that remains in place after the deal that made it visible was withdrawn.

06 / البحث وأدوات الإنتاج

أدوات البحث والإنتاج

أدوات أستخدمها في البحث ورصد الأخبار والمونتاج والنشر، مع مراجعة المخرجات قبل استخدامها تحريريًا.

OSINT / VERIFICATION

المصادر المفتوحة والتحقق الرقمي

البحث في سجلات الشركات والإفصاحات المالية والوثائق العامة للتثبّت من المعلومات، وتتبع مصادرها، وتحديد ما تثبته الأدلة وحدود دلالتها.

AI / NEWS MONITORING

الذكاء الاصطناعي والرصد الآلي
